title: Understanding the Intercept
text: The intercept \( $$\theta_0$$ \) in a regression model represents the predicted value of the dependent variable when all independent variables are zero.

title: Variables in the Model
text: In the given model, the independent variables are $$'hours_{sleep'}$$ and $$'is_{cdss'}$$. Consider what happens when both are zero.

title: Interpreting Zero Values
text: If $$'hours_{sleep'}$$ is zero, it means the student gets no sleep. If $$'is_{cdss'}$$ is zero, it means the student does not have a CDSS affiliated major.

hintAnswer: Predicted GPA for a student who gets $$0$$ hours of sleep and does not have a CDSS affiliated major.
title: Predicting GPA with Zero Values
text: What is the predicted GPA when $$'hours_{sleep'}$$ is $$0$$ and $$'is_{cdss'}$$ is 0?
choices: Predicted GPA for a student who gets $$0$$ hours of sleep and does not have a CDSS affiliated major.
Predicted increase in GPA for one additional hour of sleep, holding CDSS major status constant.
Predicted GPA difference between CDSS affiliated and non CDSS affiliated majors, holding sleep constant.
Average GPA of all students in the dataset.
